newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Tadiran Telcom is buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Tadiran Telcom is buy.

text.p: Tadrian Telecommunications was oversold at the end of last week in response to the Israeli company's announcing lower fourth-quarter earnings, NatWest Securities said in a report released on Sunday.
NatWest said the market "over-reacted" and that the decline in fourth-quarter earnings per share (EPS) to $0.15 from $0.18 had been expected.
"EPS was held back by the dilution effect from the initial public offering in second-quarter 1996 and by increases in R&D and SG&A expenses required for supporting export sales," NatWest said.
NatWest noted that the fourth quarter marked the first time more than half of Tadiran Telecom's sales came from exports.

"We are encouraged by the company's ability to gain business outside of Bezeq Israel Telecom, the dominant customer only two years ago," NatWest said. "We continue to believe that Tadiran Telecom has excellent long-term growth prospects."
NatWest said it was increasing its 1997 EPS forecast to $1.85, representing six percent growth over 1996. It said Tadiran Telecom shares were a buy at below $23, it added.
On Friday, Tadiran Telecom closed at $19 in Nasdaq trading.
